title: fragaria vesca var. zapateriana
intro: Fragaria vesca var. zapateriana, commonly known as the Iberian strawberry, is a type of wild strawberry native to the Iberian Peninsula. It is a fragaria plant, known for its edible fruit and various health benefits. The Iberian strawberry has been used in traditional medicine to treat digestive issues, its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the relief of symptoms such as sore throats and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ellagic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
